title: Refetching Queries
description: Learn how to refetch queries after mutations.

data.text: After a mutation, you often need to refetch related queries to keep the UI in sync. Apollo provides several ways to do this.

data.title: refetchQueries
Manual
Cache Update vs Refetch
data.text: Prefer cache updates over refetching when possible. Cache updates are instant and don't require network requests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Keep UI in sync with server
data.takeaway: Refetching keeps data fresh after mutations.
